config.scope: Exploratory sparse empirical residual formulas on previously exposed radial data; not a gravity operator or reinforcement-learning agent.
config.library: Four structural variables, their four squares, six pair products, and sixteen products with the four baseline variables: 30 candidates. Standardize raw inputs and each expression using fitting rows only.
config.selection: Greedy forward ridge penalized training objective constructs each path. Inner whole-galaxy validation chooses penalty and depth 0..3 by MSE; ties choose shallower depth then larger penalty. Outer labels never enter choice. Separate baseline selects penalty on identical inner folds.
config.null: Jointly shuffle four structure columns within four acceleration rank bins, first seed, repeat full nested search. Diagnostic only, not calibrated significance.
limitations: Historical development exposure persists; no pristine confirmation.
No physical group or survey holdout available.
Stellar and gas inputs are proxies with fixed mass conversion assumptions, not observed 3D density.
Predicts residuals of an existing algebraic MOND approximation, not a new force law.
No numerical field output, inferred dark mass, lens-model mass or held-out velocity enters candidate features.
No Solar System, cluster or lensing validation is supplied by this search.
